items.question: Which deity is praised as gold-mountain-like, night-powder-beautiful, all-veda-secret, and red-colored?
premises: Mallāri-deva is praised with four epithets.
The epithets include gold-mountain-like and red-colored.
The verse is a devotional salutation.
items.inference: The verse salutes Mallāri-deva as a red-colored deity bearing secret Vedic beauty.
uncertainties: raktavarṇaḥ is nominative and may not agree with the accusative object; possible fragment or sandhi.
items.plain_english: I bow to Mallāri-deva, who is like a gold mountain, beautiful with night powder, secret to all Vedas, and red-colored.
